user.title: Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in Chrome, but **do not log in yet**.
2. Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I / F12), tab **Network**, tick **Preserve log** and type `login-exit` in the filter box.
3. Log in (including the SMS code).
4. Right-click the `login-exit` line → Copy → **Copy URL**, and paste it below. The code is only valid for a few minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Albert Heijn again
reauth_confirm.description:
1. Open [the AH login page]({login_url}) in Chrome, but **do not log in yet**.
2. Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I / F12), tab **Network**, tick **Preserve log** and type `login-exit` in the filter box.
3. Log in (including the SMS code).
4. Right-click the `login-exit` line → Copy → **Copy URL**, and paste it below. The code is only valid for a few minutes.

error.invalid_link: No code found in the pasted link.
error.code_expired: AH refused the code; it probably expired. Log in again and paste a fresh link.

abort.already_configured: This AH account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different AH account than before.

init.title: Albert Heijn options
init.description: "Vaak gekocht": how many products to show, counted over how many days of receipts. Saving reloads the integration.

not_loaded.message: The Albert Heijn integration is not loaded.

unknown_receipt.message: Receipt {receipt_id} is not among your recent receipts.

search.name: Search products
search.description: Searches the AH product range and returns the products found.

zoekterm.name: Search term
zoekterm.description: What to search for, e.g. "halfvolle melk".

aantal.name: Number
aantal.description: How many products to return (1 to 50).

add_product.name: Add product to list
add_product.description: Searches for a product and puts the best match on the shopping list as a real product. Products you often buy win.

get_receipt.name: Get receipt
get_receipt.description: Fetches one of your recent receipts with all its lines and a link to the PDF. Nothing is stored.

receipt_id.name: Receipt id
receipt_id.description: Id from the `recent` attribute of the latest receipt sensor. Empty: the latest receipt.
